raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 12 (ingest 2026-01-17) was re-delivered: 668 rows versus a usual ~350, and rows with the same txn_id reappear with a later ingest_ts (05:00). Silver keeps every POSTED copy, which double-counts 2026-01-16 and inflates the gold tables. Deduplicating on txn_id, keeping the latest ingest_ts, restores one row per transaction.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED' QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC) = 1;"}}
